hotspots.title: Adorni scandal deepens
hotspots.blurb: Manuel Adorni, Argentina's Cabinet Chief, faces intense scrutiny over alleged illicit enrichment and asset laundering, with opposition parties pushing for his interpellation and censure in Congress. The scandal has exposed internal rifts within the ruling La Libertad Avanza party, particularly between factions led by Karina Milei and Patricia Bullrich.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high-stakes political fallout, moral outrage over corruption allegations, and the internal power struggle within the ruling party that threatens its stability.

The feud has raised concerns about the future of U.S.-Italy relations and Meloni's political standing.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high-profile nature of the leaders involved, the geopolitical implications of their strained relationship, and the moral outrage over perceived disrespect and diplomatic tensions.

hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high-stakes nature of coalition-building, the moral panic over far-right influence in government, and the polarized contention between the parties over key policy issues.

hotspots.title: Magyar’s corruption crackdown intensifies
hotspots.blurb: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar has launched a sweeping anti-corruption campaign, targeting high-profile figures from the previous Fidesz government. The crackdown includes the detention of former officials and the establishment of a new National Asset Recovery and Defense Office to reclaim misappropriated state funds.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high moral stakes of corruption allegations, the polarized contention between Magyar's government and Fidesz, and the alarmist framing of the crackdown as a political purge.

hotspots.title: Åkesson’s SD dominates Swedish politics
hotspots.blurb: Sweden Democrats leader Jimmie Åkesson has taken center stage in Swedish politics, proposing controversial policies such as a 'citizen veto' to block housing projects and a public map tracking convicted pedophiles. The party's rising influence has sparked intense debate and protests, particularly during Åkesson's speeches at Almedalen Week.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high moral stakes of the proposed policies, the polarized contention between SD and other parties, and the alarmist framing of the party's influence on Sweden's political landscape.
